phase3_findings.description: Re-record to a rosterless axis (complete -> not-applicable / unestablished, which must carry NO enumeration) has no strip test. Only complete -> short is exercised; the not-applicable transition is the higher-risk strip case, since if the strip regex failed to match roster rows it would leave orphaned rows and produce a confusing 'measured no roster ... rows present' refusal. A _review_roster_members(...) == {} assertion after re-recording not-applicable over a complete record would pin the strip.

phase3_findings.description: Docstring clarity: _review_roster_incoherence enforces the always-on floor hard but a gated member whose gate was TRUE yet is omitted entirely (status None) is treated like gated-off and does not block roster=complete — the validator trusts the loop to enumerate expected gated members. Consistent with the ACs and phase-3 prose (design boundary, not a defect); a one-line docstring note that the enforced guarantee is 'no missing always-on member' rather than 'the full expected roster was dispatched' would prevent a future reader assuming gated coverage is enforced.
